name: productPlan_isPlan
doc:
**乘积计划可行**：若 `p, q` 是非负且和为 1 的概率向量，
则乘积计划 `π a b = p a * q b` 是一个传输计划。
stmt:
theorem productPlan_isPlan (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    IsTransportPlan p q (fun a b => p a * q b)
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a b
    exact mul_nonneg (hp0 a) (hq0 b)
  · intro a
    rw [← Finset.mul_sum, hq1, mul_one]
  · intro b
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hp1, one_mul]

name: exists_optimal_plan
doc:
**最优传输计划存在**：概率向量 `p, q` 与任意代价 `c` 下，
存在可行计划 `π*` 使 `transportCost c π*` 在可行集上取最小值。
stmt:
theorem exists_optimal_plan (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (c : α → β → ℝ)
    (hp0 : ∀ a, 0 ≤ p a) (hp1 : ∑ a, p a = 1)
    (hq0 : ∀ b, 0 ≤ q b) (hq1 : ∑ b, q b = 1) :
    ∃ π : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q π ∧
      ∀ π' : α → β → ℝ, IsTransportPlan p q π' →
        transportCost c π ≤ transportCost c π'
proof:
by
  have hcont : Continuous fun π : α → β → ℝ => transportCost c π := by
    simp only [transportCost]
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ fun a _ =>
      continuous_finset_sum _ fun b _ =>
        (continuous_apply₂ a b).mul continuous_const
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hmin⟩ :=
    (isCompact_setOf_isTransportPlan p q).exists_isMinOn
      ⟨fun a b => p a * q b, productPlan_isPlan p q hp0 hp1 hq0 hq1⟩
      hcont.continuousOn
  exact ⟨π, hπ, fun π' hπ' => hmin hπ'⟩

name: dual_weak
doc:
**对偶弱定理**：对任意可行计划 `π` 与任意代价下界势 `(f, g)`
（即 `∀ a b, f a + g b ≤ c a b`），有
`∑ a, f a * p a + ∑ b, g b * q b ≤ transportCost c π`。

证明思路：左边 = `∑ a ∑ b, π a b * (f a + g b)`（用两组边缘约束），
再由逐项不等式 `f a + g b ≤ c a b` 与 `π a b ≥ 0` 逐项放大。
stmt:
theorem dual_weak (p : α → ℝ) (q : β → ℝ) (c : α → β → ℝ)
    (π : α → β → ℝ) (f : α → ℝ) (g : β → ℝ)
    (hπ : IsTransportPlan p q π) (hfg : ∀ a b, f a + g b ≤ c a b) :
    (∑ a, f a * p a) + (∑ b, g b * q b) ≤ transportCost c π
proof:
by
  have h1 : ∑ a, f a * p a = ∑ a, ∑ b, f a * π a b := by
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [← hπ.2.1 a, Finset.mul_sum]
  have h2 : ∑ b, g b * q b = ∑ a, ∑ b, g b * π a b := by
    calc ∑ b, g b * q b = ∑ b, ∑ a, g b * π a b := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
          rw [← hπ.2.2 b, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, g b * π a b := Finset.sum_comm
  have hkey : (∑ a, f a * p a) + (∑ b, g b * q b) =
      ∑ a, ∑ b, π a b * (f a + g b) := by
    calc (∑ a, f a * p a) + (∑ b, g b * q b)
        = (∑ a, ∑ b, f a * π a b) + (∑ a, ∑ b, g b * π a b) := by rw [h1, h2]
      _ = ∑ a, ((∑ b, f a * π a b) + (∑ b, g b * π a b)) := by
            rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      _ = ∑ a, ∑ b, π a b * (f a + g b) := by
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
            rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
            ring
  rw [hkey, transportCost]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun b _ =>
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfg a b) (hπ.1 a b)

name: kp_lipschitz_bound
doc: 1-Lipschitz 势的差分界（去掉绝对值的一侧）：`f a - f b ≤ |a - b|`。
stmt:
theorem kp_lipschitz_bound {f : Fin n → ℝ} (hf : IsOneLipschitz f) (a b : Fin n) :
    f a - f b ≤ |(a : ℝ) - (b : ℝ)|
proof: le_trans (le_abs_self _) (hf a b)

name: pZobs_eq_sum_sum_obs
doc: 展开形式：`P(Z=z) = Σ_x Σ_y P(x,y,z)`（把 `obsXZ` 定义展开，供调整公式使用）。
stmt:
lemma pZobs_eq_sum_sum_obs (M : BinSCM) (z : Bool) :
    pZobs M z = ∑ x : Bool, ∑ y : Bool, obs M x y z
proof:
by
  rw [← sum_obsXZ_eq_pZobs M z]
  rfl

name: backdoor_adjustment
doc:
**后门调整公式（主定理，定理 5）**：

在正性 / 重叠假设 `hpos : ∀ x z, 0 < P(X=x, Z=z)` 下，
对后门准则成立的图 `Z → X → Y`、`Z → Y`（无未观测混杂，
由 `BinSCM` 的因子化外生分布保证），

`P(Y=y | do(X=x)) = Σ_z P(Z=z) · P(Y=y | X=x, Z=z)`。

证明路线：先用定理 3 把 `doY` 写成 `Σ_z pZobs · ycond`，
再用逐点核心引理把 `ycond` 换成观测条件概率 `condYZ`。
stmt:
theorem backdoor_adjustment (M : BinSCM) (x y : Bool)
    (hpos : ∀ x z, 0 < obsXZ M x z) :
    doY M x y = ∑ z : Bool, pZobs M z * condYZ M x y z
proof:
by
  rw [doY_eq_sum_pZobs_ycond M x y]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro z _
  exact pZobs_mul_ycond_eq_condYZ M hpos x y z

name: constrainedDenom_nonneg
doc: 分母非负 —— **无需任何假设**。（对应 maskedDenom_nonneg:52）
stmt:
lemma constrainedDenom_nonneg {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n) (s : Fin n -> Real) :
    0 <= constrainedDenom allowed s
proof:
by
  unfold constrainedDenom
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => by
    by_cases h : allowed t = true
    · rw [if_pos h]
      exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (s t))
    · rw [if_neg h])

name: constrainedDenom_pos
doc: 允许集非空则分母**为正**。（对应 maskedDenom_pos:65）
stmt:
lemma constrainedDenom_pos {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n) (s : Fin n -> Real)
    (hne : ∃ t, allowed t = true) : 0 < constrainedDenom allowed s
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := hne
  unfold constrainedDenom
  refine Finset.sum_pos' (fun t _ => ?_) ⟨t0, Finset.mem_univ t0, ?_⟩
  · by_cases h : allowed t = true
    · rw [if_pos h]
      exact le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (s t))
    · rw [if_neg h]
  · rw [if_pos ht0]
    exact Real.exp_pos (s t0)

name: constrainedSoftmax_pos_of_allowed
doc:
**定理一'（对偶：允许则严格正）**：允许集内概率**严格为正**（分母为正时）。
于是掩码**没有误杀**可行 token（不是「一律清零」的平凡掩码）。
（对应 maskedSoftmax_pos_of_mask:126）
stmt:
theorem constrainedSoftmax_pos_of_allowed {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) (t : Fin n) (hne : ∃ u, allowed u = true) (ht : allowed t = true) :
    0 < constrainedSoftmax allowed s t
proof:
by
  unfold constrainedSoftmax
  rw [if_pos ht]
  exact div_pos (Real.exp_pos (s t)) (constrainedDenom_pos allowed s hne)

name: constrainedSoftmax_support_iff_allowed
doc:
**支撑-允许集一致性（结构定理）**：概率的**支撑**恰等于允许集。
把定理一（正向）与定理一'（反向）合成**充要条件**，
这排除了「掩码只清 0 但允许集是空的」这类退化读法。
stmt:
theorem constrainedSoftmax_support_iff_allowed {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) (hne : ∃ u, allowed u = true) (t : Fin n) :
    constrainedSoftmax allowed s t ≠ 0 ↔ allowed t = true
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra ht
    exact h (constrainedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_allowed allowed s t ht)
  · intro ht
    exact ne_of_gt (constrainedSoftmax_pos_of_allowed allowed s t hne ht)

name: constrained_via_maskedSoftmax
doc:
**对应定理**：constrainedSoftmax = RealMaskFamily.maskedSoftmax 在哑提升下。
两侧定义域不同（一维 vs 二维），本定理是它们**唯一**的合法桥。
stmt:
theorem constrained_via_maskedSoftmax {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n) (s : Fin n -> Real)
    (i t : Fin n) :
    constrainedSoftmax allowed s t = maskedSoftmax (liftToPosMask allowed) s i t
proof:
by
  unfold constrainedSoftmax constrainedDenom maskedSoftmax maskedDenom liftToPosMask
  rfl

name: constrained_sum_one_via_realMaskFamily
doc:
**复用确认（非重造）**：把对应定理与 RealMaskFamily 的**已证**行随机定理复合，
重新得到本文件定理三。这证明 S3 的四条**确实**是模板定理的特例。
stmt:
theorem constrained_sum_one_via_realMaskFamily {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) (i : Fin n) (hne : ∃ t, allowed t = true) :
    (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) = 1
proof:
by
  have hne' : ∃ j, liftToPosMask allowed i j := by
    obtain ⟨t0, ht0⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨t0, ht0⟩
  calc (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t)
      = ∑ t, maskedSoftmax (liftToPosMask allowed) s i t := by
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => constrained_via_maskedSoftmax allowed s i t)
    _ = 1 := maskedSoftmax_sum_one (liftToPosMask allowed) s i hne'

name: empty_allowed_row_sum_ne_one
doc:
**负对照 1（消融：非空假设是承重的）**：允许集**空**时，
constrainedSoftmax_sum_one 的结论**为假**——即定理三的非空假设**不可去掉**。

见证：n = 2、allowed 恒 false、s 恒 0。此时分母 = 0，每个概率 = 0/0 = 0
（Lean 的 Real 除法是全函数），故 Sigma p = 0 ≠ 1。
这不是「证明失败」，是**数学事实**：全假掩码下根本没有概率分布。
stmt:
theorem empty_allowed_row_sum_ne_one :
    ∃ (allowed : FeasibleMask 2) (s : Fin 2 -> Real),
      (¬ (∃ t, allowed t = true)) ∧ (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) ≠ 1
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun _ => false, fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := h
    exact Bool.noConfusion ht
  · intro hsum
    have hzero : ∀ t : Fin 2,
        constrainedSoftmax (fun _ : Fin 2 => false) (fun _ => 0) t = 0 := by
      intro t
      unfold constrainedSoftmax constrainedDenom
      simp only [if_false, Bool.false_eq_true]
      simp
    have hsum0 : (∑ t : Fin 2,
        constrainedSoftmax (fun _ : Fin 2 => false) (fun _ => 0) t) = 0 := by
      simp only [hzero, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
      norm_num
    rw [hsum0] at hsum
    norm_num at hsum

name: posMask_row_is_dummy
doc:
**负对照 2（不可替代性：位置掩码的行指标是哑的）**：
liftToPosMask 的**行指标确实被消掉**：任意两行给出**同一个** softmax。

即：若有人声称「直接用 RealMaskFamily 的 mask 就是约束解码」，
则他必须解释**为什么行指标 i 不携带信息**。本定理把这个「解释」变成机器事实：
它不携带信息，于是二维掩码的额外结构在约束解码中是无用的，
故正确做法是**一维** FeasibleMask（S1），而不是复用二维类型。
stmt:
theorem posMask_row_is_dummy {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n) (s : Fin n -> Real)
    (i i' t : Fin n) :
    maskedSoftmax (liftToPosMask allowed) s i t
      = maskedSoftmax (liftToPosMask allowed) s i' t
proof:
by
  rw [← constrained_via_maskedSoftmax allowed s i t,
      ← constrained_via_maskedSoftmax allowed s i' t]

name: mask_actually_changes_distribution
doc:
**负对照 3（反驳可能：掩码确实改变分布，不是恒等）**：
存在**具体数值**见证：同一 logits，掩码与非掩码给出**不同的概率**。

若掩码 softmax 恒等于普通 softmax，则本文件的全部定理**空洞**
（「约束解码」什么都没做）。本定理用显式数值排除该退化。

见证：n = 2、s = (0,0)（两点等概率 1/2）、allowed = (true,false)。
掩码后 p_0 = 1、p_1 = 0，与未掩码的 1/2 **不等**。
stmt:
theorem mask_actually_changes_distribution :
    ∃ (allowed : FeasibleMask 2) (s : Fin 2 -> Real) (t : Fin 2),
      constrainedSoftmax allowed s t
        ≠ Real.exp (s t) / (∑ u : Fin 2, Real.exp (s u))
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun t => if t = 0 then true else false, fun _ => 0, 0, ?_⟩
  have hmask : constrainedSoftmax (fun t : Fin 2 => if t = 0 then true else false)
      (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) 0 = 1 := by
    unfold constrainedSoftmax constrainedDenom
    rw [if_pos (by simp : (if (0 : Fin 2) = 0 then true else false) = true)]
    have hdenom : (∑ u : Fin 2, (if (if u = 0 then true else false) = true
        then Real.exp ((fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) u) else 0)) = 1 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
      norm_num
    rw [hdenom]
    norm_num
  have hplain : Real.exp ((fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) 0) /
      (∑ u : Fin 2, Real.exp ((fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) u)) = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
    norm_num
  rw [hmask, hplain]
  norm_num

name: nonempty_allowed_row_sum_eq_one_witness
doc:
**负对照 4（掩码非平凡：存在允许集非空的实例）**：
给出**具体见证** allowed = (true,false)、s = (0,0)，
满足非空假设且行随机性**真的成立**（Sigma p = 1）。
于是定理三**不是**空泛的：它的假设可满足、结论可用。
stmt:
theorem nonempty_allowed_row_sum_eq_one_witness :
    ∃ (allowed : FeasibleMask 2) (s : Fin 2 -> Real),
      (∃ t, allowed t = true) ∧ (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) = 1
proof:
by
  refine ⟨fun t => if t = 0 then true else false, fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  · have hne : ∃ t : Fin 2, (fun t : Fin 2 => if t = 0 then true else false) t = true := by
      exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    exact constrainedSoftmax_sum_one _ _ hne

end Lattice

name: not_allowed_contribution_zero
doc:
**不可行 token 的贡献为零（期望层）**：
对任意权重 `w`，不允许的 token `t` 对加权和的贡献**恰为 0**。
这是 `constrainedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_allowed` 的**推论形态**——
后者只谈单个概率，本定理把它变成**求和中的一项消失**，
这正是「掩码使不可行 token 无法被采样」的可加表述。
stmt:
theorem not_allowed_contribution_zero {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) (t : Fin n) (ht : ¬ allowed t = true) (w : Fin n -> Real) :
    constrainedSoftmax allowed s t * w t = 0
proof:
by
  rw [constrainedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_allowed allowed s t ht, zero_mul]

name: mass_concentrated_on_allowed
doc:
**允许集上的概率质量恰为 1**：
把求和拆成「允许部分」与「禁止部分」，后者质量恰为 0。
这**不是** `constrainedSoftmax_sum_one` 的重述：后者对**全**求和，
本定理给出**分拆**后的质量分布，从而定位质量**全部**落在允许集内。
stmt:
theorem mass_concentrated_on_allowed {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) (hne : ∃ t, allowed t = true) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun t => allowed t = true)).sum (fun t => constrainedSoftmax allowed s t)
      = 1
proof:
by
  have hzero : ∀ t ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun t : Fin n => ¬ allowed t = true),
      constrainedSoftmax allowed s t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    exact constrainedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_allowed allowed s t (by
      simpa using (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2)
  have hsplit := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := Finset.univ)
    (p := fun t : Fin n => allowed t = true) (f := fun t => constrainedSoftmax allowed s t)
  have hcompl : (∑ t ∈ Finset.filter (fun t : Fin n => ¬ allowed t = true) Finset.univ,
      constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) = 0 :=
    Finset.sum_eq_zero hzero
  have htotal := constrainedSoftmax_sum_one allowed s hne
                                              
  rw [hcompl, add_zero] at hsplit
                                        
  exact hsplit.trans htotal

name: allowed_is_convex_weights
doc:
**凸组合表述**：在允许集非空时，掩码 softmax 把 logits 的指数
按允许集内的权重**凸组合**起来——权重非负（定理二）且和为 1（定理三）。
本定理把这两条**合取**成一个可复用的假设包，供下游一次性使用。
stmt:
theorem allowed_is_convex_weights {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n) (s : Fin n -> Real)
    (hne : ∃ t, allowed t = true) :
    (∀ t, 0 <= constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) ∧
      (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) = 1
proof:
by
  exact ⟨fun t => constrainedSoftmax_nonneg allowed s t,
         constrainedSoftmax_sum_one allowed s hne⟩

name: support_from_decoded_constraints
doc:
**可行性由约束集经投影导出（消费者侧的核心推论）**：
若 token 序列解码到约束集 `cs`，则掩码 softmax 的**支撑**恰为
`allowedByConstraints cs tok` 的允许集。

本定理**逐字消费** `constrained_agrees_with_constraint_set`，
并把它包装成**消费者可调用的形式**（把 `DecodesTo` 与掩码投影一起给出），
使下游模块只需给出「解码成功」这一事实。
stmt:
theorem support_from_decoded_constraints {n : Nat} (cs : ConstraintSet)
    (tok : Fin n -> SymToken) (ts : List SymToken) (hts : DecodesTo ts cs)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) (hne : ∃ t, allowedByConstraints cs tok t = true) (t : Fin n) :
    constrainedSoftmax (allowedByConstraints cs tok) s t ≠ 0 ↔
      allowedByConstraints cs tok t = true
proof: constrained_agrees_with_constraint_set cs tok ts hts s hne t

name: feasibility_is_caller_obligation
doc:
⭐ **本文件最重要的一条（反向使用负对照）**：
`RealConstrainedDecoding.empty_allowed_row_sum_ne_one` 证明
「允许集为空时行随机性**为假**」。
本定理把它**反向**读成一条**义务**：

    任何声称「掩码后是概率分布」的调用方，**必须**提供非空见证。

形式化：不存在「允许集为空 **且** 概率和为 1」的实例。
这**不是**重述负对照——后者给出一个**具体**反例（allowed 恒 false），
本定理给出**全称否定**（对**任意** n / allowed / s，二者不可兼得）。

⚠ 这条定理的**工程内容**：约束解码的实现必须**检测**「允许集为空」
并在该情形**报错或回退**，而不能静默归一化——否则会得到 0/0 的 `NaN` 类退化
（Lean 的 `Real` 除法是全函数，静默给出 0，**掩盖**了错误）。
stmt:
theorem feasibility_is_caller_obligation {n : Nat} (allowed : FeasibleMask n)
    (s : Fin n -> Real) :
    ¬ (¬ (∃ t, allowed t = true) ∧ (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) = 1)
proof:
by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨hempty, hsum⟩ := h
                                    
  have hzero : ∀ t : Fin n, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t = 0 := by
    intro t
    refine constrainedSoftmax_eq_zero_of_not_allowed allowed s t ?_
    intro ht
    exact hempty ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hsum0 : (∑ t, constrainedSoftmax allowed s t) = 0 := by
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun t _ => hzero t)
  rw [hsum0] at hsum
  norm_num at hsum

end Lattice

    rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
  have hcast : ((n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) - 1 := by

name: chain_distill_bound_lipschitz
doc:
定理四'（非线性 Lipschitz 层版，块级蒸馏入口）：教师层 Ft 与学生对层
Fs 同为 Ls i-Lipschitz（hLt/hLs），逐层输出对齐误差 ‖Ft i y − Fs i y‖ ≤ ε i
（输入无关）⟹ 端到端 ‖ChainFwd Ft n x − ChainFwd Fs n x‖
≤ Σ_{i<n} (∏_{j∈Ioo i n} Ls j)·ε i。
角色互换实例化 `RealQuantizedError.quantized_chain_error_lipschitz`
（F := Fs、Fq := Ft）：接入块级蒸馏时，单块 Lipschitz 常数（如
RealBlockLipschitz/RealModelChain 的 Lb）代入 Ls i、逐块输出对齐误差
代入 ε i；诚实假设：师生层共享常数上界 Ls i（若不同取 max）。
stmt:
theorem chain_distill_bound_lipschitz (Ft Fs : ℕ → E → E) (Ls ε : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hLt : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ x y, ‖Ft i x - Ft i y‖ ≤ Ls i * ‖x - y‖)
    (hLs : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ x y, ‖Fs i x - Fs i y‖ ≤ Ls i * ‖x - y‖)
    (hL0 : ∀ i, i < n → 0 ≤ Ls i)
    (hε : ∀ i, i < n → ∀ y, ‖Ft i y - Fs i y‖ ≤ ε i) :
    ∀ x, ‖ChainFwd Ft n x - ChainFwd Fs n x‖
      ≤ ∑ i in Finset.range n, (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i n, Ls j) * ε i
proof:
by
  intro x
  exact quantized_chain_error_lipschitz Fs Ft Ls ε n hLs hLt hL0 hε x

name: layerOut_not_injective
doc:
⭐⭐ **`Layer` 到行为的映射非单射**（真正的不可逆性所在）。

**见证**：`[]`（空层）与 `[{ w := [], b := 0 }]`（含一个零层）是**不同**的 `Layer`，
但二者对**任何**输入 `x` 的**全部**神经元输出都为零
（空层：全称量词在空表上**空洞为真**；单零层：由 `zeroLayer_out`）。

⚠ **诚实标注（`PROCESS.md §2.2`）**：本条**不是** `recover` 的性质，
而是**它上层**（行为语义）的性质。登记它是为了**防止把两种不可逆性混为一谈**
—— 本项目已登记过「三链不统一到『商可逆』」的教训（`PROCESS.md §9`，依据 `B206/B209/B223`）。
stmt:
theorem layerOut_not_injective :
    ¬ Function.Injective (fun ls : Layer => fun x : List Int => ∀ l ∈ ls, LayerOut l x = 0)
proof:
by
  intro hinj
           
  have hne : ([] : Layer) ≠ [{ w := [], b := 0 }] := by
    intro h
    have hlen := congrArg List.length h
    simp at hlen
               
  have heq :
      (fun x : List Int => ∀ l ∈ ([] : Layer), LayerOut l x = 0)
        = (fun x : List Int => ∀ l ∈ [{ w := [], b := 0 }], LayerOut l x = 0) := by
    funext x
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro _ l hl
                                                
      have : l = ({ w := [], b := 0 } : LinearLayer) := by simpa using hl
      rw [this]
      exact zeroLayer_out x
    · intro h l hl
                                    
      simp at hl
  exact hne (hinj heq)

name: zeroFixing_false_of_witness
doc:
**可判定性（否定侧的统一入口）**：只要能给出非零零点 `y`，零集假设即为假。
**注意本判据不需要 `σ 0 = 0`**——证法直接对 `y` 用零集假设的
`act y = 0 → y = 0` 方向（该方向对任何 `act` 都成立，无需归一前提）。

**注意 适用范围（本轮实测的教训）**：它只覆盖「**有非零零点**」这一失败机制，
**不覆盖「零集为空」（`σ 0 ≠ 0`）**——`act_sigmoidZ n = 2n+1` 在 ℤ 上无零点，
但 `ZeroFixing` 仍为假。故本文件对否定侧分两条入口：
本定理（有非零零点）与 `neg_zeroFixing_sigmoidZ`（`σ 0 ≠ 0` 直接反证）。
stmt:
theorem zeroFixing_false_of_witness (act : ℤ → ℤ) (y : ℤ) (hyne : y ≠ 0) (hy : act y = 0) :
    ¬ ZeroFixing act
proof: fun h => hyne ((h y).mp hy)

name: zeroFixing_of_bounded_no_witness
doc:
**可判定性（显式验证版）**：若 `act 0 = 0`、`act` 在某个足够大的盒上通过穷举检验，
且盒外不存在非零零点，则零集假设成立。
这把「可判定」拆成**可执行的有限检验 + 一条覆盖论证**。

（`h0` 用于零集假设的**逆方向** `0 = 0 → act 0 = 0`；
`hbox` 的第一分量已含 `act 0 = 0`，但显式传入使接口不必依赖内核的内部结构。）
stmt:
theorem zeroFixing_of_bounded_no_witness (act : ℤ → ℤ) (n : ℕ) (h0 : act 0 = 0)
    (hbox : zeroFixingHoldsBounded act n = true)
    (hout : ∀ y : ℤ, n < y.natAbs → act y = 0 → y = 0) : ZeroFixing act
proof:
by
  refine fun y => ⟨fun hy => ?_, fun hy => hy ▸ h0⟩
  by_cases hle : y.natAbs ≤ n
  · exact zeroFixing_box_only act n hbox y hle hy
  · exact hout y (by omega) hy

name: decidable_zeroFixing_leakyReluZ
doc:
**判定 2（严格单调激活）**：整数 leaky ReLU（负斜率 `1`、正斜率 `2`，比值 `1/2`）
满足零集假设（判据 1 的实例；证明走 `StrictMono` + `act 0 = 0`）。

**STYLE 陷阱规避（本轮实测两处）**：
(i) `omega` 对 `if` 项是黑的——`if_pos (by omega : 0 ≤ x)` 报
`omega could not prove the goal: No usable constraints found`；
必须在 `unfold` **之前**把条件取出。
(ii) **前提 `hxy : x < y` 本身推不出 `0 ≤ x`**（首轮实测：
`have hx0 : 0 ≤ x := by omega` 报
`a possible counterexample may satisfy b ≤ -1, a - b ≥ 1`）——
必须对 `x`/`y` 的符号**分四种情形**。
stmt: theorem decidable_zeroFixing_leakyReluZ : ZeroFixing act_leakyReluZ
proof:
by
  have h0 : act_leakyReluZ 0 = 0 := by norm_num [act_leakyReluZ]
  refine zeroFixingZ_of_strictMono act_leakyReluZ h0 ?_
  intro x y hxy
  show act_leakyReluZ x < act_leakyReluZ y
  unfold act_leakyReluZ
  by_cases hx : 0 ≤ x
  · rw [if_pos hx]
    by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
    · rw [if_pos hy]; omega
    · exact absurd hxy (by omega)
  · rw [if_neg hx]
    by_cases hy : 0 ≤ y
    · rw [if_pos hy]; omega
    · rw [if_neg hy]; omega

name: neg_zeroFixing_sigmoidZ
doc:
**判定 3（严格单调、零集为空）**：整数 sigmoid 代用 `n ↦ 2n+1` **不**满足零集假设。

**注意 数值复核（STYLE §5 的教训，本轮实测命中）**：`2n + 1 = 0` 在 ℤ 上**无解**
（解是 `n = -1/2`）——故该激活的**零集为空**，而不是「有非零零点」。
首轮我误写了见证 `-1`（其实 `act_sigmoidZ (-1) = -1 ≠ 0`），
`decide` 直接证伪了那条**假命题**。正确的失败机制是 `σ 0 ≠ 0`：
零集假设要求 `act 0 = 0`，而 `act 0 = 1`。故此处用 `(h 0).mpr rfl` 取 `act 0 = 0` 再矛盾。

对照 `RealExtractInvertibility.sigmoid_injective`：`sigmoid` 严格单调且**值域在 `(0,1)`**，
同样零集为空、`σ 0 = 1/2 ≠ 0`——`sigmoidZ` 是这个事实的整数刻度版。
stmt: theorem neg_zeroFixing_sigmoidZ : ¬ ZeroFixing act_sigmoidZ
proof:
by
  intro h
  have h0 : act_sigmoidZ 0 = 0 := (h 0).mpr rfl
  exact absurd h0 (by norm_num [act_sigmoidZ])

name: sq_penalty_exact_matrix
doc:
**`PenaltyExact` holds for a matrix constraint with a surjective weight matrix.**

This closes the last case of `lift.embed.local_minimiser_exact` that the perturbation argument reaches:
every local minimiser of `Σₖ rₖ²` satisfies `A x + b = 0`, provided `A` can produce any residual as a
direction. No derivative and no norm appear in the proof.

What is *not* claimed: that every matrix used in practice is surjective. A matrix with more rows than
columns cannot be, and then the constraint may be unsatisfiable -- which is the honest boundary, and it
is the same reason `zero_slope_not_exact` carries a slope hypothesis in the one-variable case.

name: not_localMin_of_resid_ne_zero
doc:
**A point with a nonzero residual is not a local minimum**, at any arity.

`IsLocalMin` unfolds to `∀ᶠ y in nhds x, L x ≤ L y`, which `Metric.eventually_nhds_iff` turns into
`∃ ε > 0, ∀ y, dist y x < ε → L x ≤ L y`. The scale is bounded above by both `1` (so it lies in the
`(0, 2)` range where the loss decreases) and `ε / (2·(|c| + 1))` (so the point stays inside the
ball). Nothing here depends on the arity beyond the two lemmas above.
stmt:
theorem not_localMin_of_resid_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (a b x : Fin n → ℝ) (j : Fin n) (ha : a j ≠ 0)
    (hr : residN a b x j ≠ 0) : ¬ IsLocalMin (lossN a b) x
proof:
by
  intro hmin
  rw [IsLocalMin, IsMinFilter, Metric.eventually_nhds_iff] at hmin
  obtain ⟨ε, hεpos, hε⟩ := hmin
                                                                                      
  set d : ℝ := |-(residN a b x j / a j)| with hd
  set s : ℝ := min 1 (ε / (2 * (d + 1))) with hs
  have hbase0 : 0 < ε / (2 * (d + 1)) := by positivity
  have hden : (0:ℝ) < 2 * (d + 1) := by positivity
  have hs0 : 0 < s := by
    rw [hs]; exact lt_min one_pos hbase0
  have hsle : s ≤ ε / (2 * (d + 1)) := by
    rw [hs]; exact min_le_right _ _
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hs]; exact min_le_left _ _
  have hs2 : s < 2 := by linarith
  have hd0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ d := by rw [hd]; exact abs_nonneg _
  have hsabs : |s * (-(residN a b x j / a j))| < ε := by
    have heq : |s * (-(residN a b x j / a j))| = s * d := by
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hs0, hd, mul_comm]
    rw [heq]
    have hmono : s * d ≤ ε / (2 * (d + 1)) * d :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsle hd0
    have hstrict : ε / (2 * (d + 1)) * d < ε := by
      rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ hden]
      nlinarith [hεpos, hd0]
    linarith
  have hle := hε (pertPointN_dist_lt a b x j hεpos hsabs)
  have hlt := lossN_perturb_lt a b x j ha hr hs0 hs2
  linarith

name: localMin_of_feasible

name: two_dim_posdef_iff
doc:
**2×2 Sylvester 判据（正定）**：`[[a,b],[b,d]]` 正定 ⟺ `a > 0 ∧ a·d − b² > 0`。

证明：恒等式 `q(v) = a·(v₀ + (b/a)v₁)² + ((ad−b²)/a)·v₁²`；
反向用 `v = (1,0)` 得 `a > 0`，用 `v = (−b, a)`（非零，因 a > 0）得 `a(ad−b²) > 0`。
stmt:
theorem two_dim_posdef_iff (a b d : ℝ) :
    PosDefQ (sym2 a b d) ↔ 0 < a ∧ 0 < a * d - b * b
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hv1 : (![1, 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := vec2_ne_zero (x := 1) (y := 0) one_ne_zero
    have hq1 : quadForm (sym2 a b d) (![1, 0] : Fin 2 → ℝ) = a := by
      rw [quadForm_sym2_expanded]
      rw [vec2_zero, vec2_one]
      ring
    have ha : 0 < a := by
      have := h _ hv1
      rwa [hq1] at this
    have hv2 : (![-b, a] : Fin 2 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := vec2_ne_zero_of_second (x := -b) (y := a) (ne_of_gt ha)
    have hq2 : quadForm (sym2 a b d) (![-b, a] : Fin 2 → ℝ) = a * (a * d - b * b) := by
      rw [quadForm_sym2_expanded]
      rw [vec2_zero, vec2_one]
      ring
    have hd : 0 < a * (a * d - b * b) := by
      have := h _ hv2
      rwa [hq2] at this
    exact ⟨ha, by nlinarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hdet⟩ v hv
    have hane : a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ha
    have hident : quadForm (sym2 a b d) v
        = a * (v 0 + (b / a) * v 1) ^ 2 + ((a * d - b * b) / a) * (v 1) ^ 2 := by
      rw [quadForm_sym2]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hc1 : 0 ≤ a * (v 0 + (b / a) * v 1) ^ 2 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt ha) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hc2 : 0 ≤ ((a * d - b * b) / a) * (v 1) ^ 2 :=
      mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (div_pos hdet ha)) (sq_nonneg _)
    have hle : 0 ≤ quadForm (sym2 a b d) v := by rw [hident]; linarith
    have hne : quadForm (sym2 a b d) v ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      have hsum0 : a * (v 0 + (b / a) * v 1) ^ 2 + ((a * d - b * b) / a) * (v 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by
        rw [← hident]
        exact h0
      have hz1 : a * (v 0 + (b / a) * v 1) ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith

name: second_order_necessary_multidim
doc:
**多维二阶必要条件**：x 是 F 的局部极小，沿每个方向 v 的一维限制
`t ↦ F (x + t·v)` 在 0 的邻域上二阶可导、二阶导连续，且其二阶导在 0 处等于
`quadForm H v`，则 `∀ v, 0 ≤ quadForm H v`（Hessian 半正定）。

证明：由 `IsLocalMin F x` 与路径映射 `t ↦ x + t·v` 的连续性得路径在 0 处的局部极小
（`Filter.Tendsto.eventually`）；对路径函数逐方向应用一维的
`RealKKTSecondOrder.second_order_necessary`。
stmt:
theorem second_order_necessary_multidim {n : ℕ} {F : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ}
    {H : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ} {x : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hmin : IsLocalMin F x)
    (hcont : ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, ContinuousOn (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v)) (Ioo (-1) 1))
    (hdiff : ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, DifferentiableOn ℝ (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v)) (Ioo (-1) 1))
    (hd1 : ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, ContinuousOn (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v))) (Ioo (-1) 1))
    (hd2 : ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, ContinuousAt (deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v)))) 0)
    (hhess : ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, deriv (deriv (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v))) 0 = quadForm H v) :
    ∀ v : Fin n → ℝ, 0 ≤ quadForm H v
proof:
by
  intro v
  have hpath : IsLocalMin (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v)) 0 := by
    have hφ : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => x + t • v) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 x) := by
      have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => t • v) (0 : ℝ) := continuousAt_id.smul_const v
      have h2 : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => x) (0 : ℝ) := continuousAt_const
      have h3 : ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => x + t • v) (0 : ℝ) := h2.add h1
      simpa using h3.tendsto
    have hev := hφ.eventually hmin
    filter_upwards [hev] with t ht
    simpa using ht
  have hbound := second_order_necessary (fun t : ℝ => F (x + t • v)) 0 1 one_pos hpath
    (by simpa using hcont v) (by simpa using hdiff v) (by simpa using hd1 v)
    (by simpa using hd2 v)
  rw [hhess v] at hbound
  exact hbound

name: one_add_lower_bound
doc:
**`I + W` 的范数下界**。

若 `‖W‖ ≤ Lw`，则对任意 `h` 有 `(1 − Lw) * ‖h‖ ≤ ‖h + W h‖`。

⚠ **不需要 `Lw < 1`** —— 该假设在本定理中不被使用（见文件头 §四（一））。
`Lw < 1` 在 `one_add_injective` 才是承重的。

证明：`‖h + W h‖ ≥ ‖h‖ − ‖−W h‖ = ‖h‖ − ‖W h‖ ≥ ‖h‖ − Lw‖h‖`。
stmt:
theorem one_add_lower_bound
    (W : E →L[ℝ] E) (Lw : ℝ) (hW : ‖W‖ ≤ Lw) (h : E) :
    (1 - Lw) * ‖h‖ ≤ ‖h + W h‖
proof:
by
  have hWb : ‖W h‖ ≤ Lw * ‖h‖ := by
    calc ‖W h‖ ≤ ‖W‖ * ‖h‖ := W.le_opNorm h
      _ ≤ Lw * ‖h‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hW (norm_nonneg h)
                                            
  have hrt : ‖h‖ - ‖W h‖ ≤ ‖h + W h‖ := by
    have h1 := abs_norm_sub_norm_le h (-(W h))
    rw [abs_le] at h1
    rw [norm_neg, sub_neg_eq_add] at h1
    exact h1.2
  calc (1 - Lw) * ‖h‖ = ‖h‖ - Lw * ‖h‖ := by ring
    _ ≤ ‖h‖ - ‖W h‖ := by linarith
    _ ≤ ‖h + W h‖ := hrt

name: metric_eq_kernel_expansion
doc:
**距离–核恒等式（任务指定核心恒等式）**：设 `Φ` 是核 `K` 的特征映射
（即 `K a b = ⟪Φ a, Φ b⟫`，把有限 `Φ` 写成逐点和），则

    `‖Φ x − Φ y‖² = K x x − 2·K x y + K y y`。

这条是「核 = 特征映射内积」的直接后果，也是核方法中把核当作「平方距离」使用
（如 `K(x,x) − 2K(x,y) + K(y,y) ≥ 0`）的代数依据。

theorem metric_eq_kernel_expansion {n : ℕ} {K : α → α → ℝ} (Phi : α → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ a b, K a b = ∑ p, Phi a p * Phi b p) (a b : α) :
    (∑ p, (Phi a p - Phi b p) ^ 2) = K a a - 2 * K a b + K b b
proof:
by
  rw [hK a a, hK a b, hK b b]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  ring

theorem metric_kernel_nonneg {n : ℕ} {K : α → α → ℝ} (Phi : α → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ a b, K a b = ∑ p, Phi a p * Phi b p) (a b : α) :
    0 ≤ K a a - 2 * K a b + K b b

  rw [← metric_eq_kernel_expansion Phi hK a b]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => sq_nonneg _

name: kernel_metric_zero_iff
doc:
**核距离为零 ⟺ 特征映射相等**：`K a a − 2K a b + K b b = 0 ↔ Φ a = Φ b`
（平方和为零 ⟺ 每项为零）。
stmt:
theorem kernel_metric_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {K : α → α → ℝ} (Phi : α → Fin n → ℝ)
    (hK : ∀ a b, K a b = ∑ p, Phi a p * Phi b p) (a b : α) :
    K a a - 2 * K a b + K b b = 0 ↔ Phi a = Phi b
proof:
by
  rw [← metric_eq_kernel_expansion Phi hK a b, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
    (fun p _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext p
    have hp := h p (Finset.mem_univ p)
    have : Phi a p - Phi b p = 0 := pow_eq_zero hp
    linarith
  · intro h p _
    rw [h]
    ring

**实谱定理（存在形式）**：存在正交矩阵 `U` 与实向量 `lam`，
使 `Uᵀ U = 1` 且 `A = U · diag lam · Uᵀ`。
stmt:
theorem symmetric_spectral_theorem (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    ∃ (U : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (lam : Fin n → ℝ),
      Uᵀ * U = 1 ∧ A = U * diagonal lam * Uᵀ
proof:
⟨(hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ), hA.eigenvalues,
    symmetric_eigenvectorUnitary_transpose_mul A hA, symmetric_spectral_theorem_eigen A hA⟩

name: symmetric_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues
doc: 实对称矩阵的迹 = 特征值之和（由谱定理 + 迹的循环性）。
stmt:
theorem symmetric_trace_eq_sum_eigenvalues (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    Matrix.trace A = ∑ i, hA.eigenvalues i
proof:
by
  have h := congr_arg Matrix.trace (hA.star_mul_self_mul_eq_diagonal)
  rw [Matrix.trace_mul_cycle] at h
  have hunit : (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) *
      star (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff).mp (hA.eigenvectorUnitary).2
  rw [hunit, Matrix.one_mul] at h
  rw [h, Matrix.trace_diagonal]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, RCLike.ofReal_real_eq_id, id_eq]

name: symmetric_frobenius_eq_sum_eigenvalues_sq
doc:
**实对称矩阵的 Frobenius 平方 = 特征值平方和**：
`∑ᵢⱼ Aᵢⱼ² = ∑ᵢ λᵢ²`。
stmt:
theorem symmetric_frobenius_eq_sum_eigenvalues_sq (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hA : A.IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, A i j ^ 2) = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2
proof:
by
  have hAt : Aᵀ = A := (real_isHermitian_iff_transpose A).mp hA
  have hU := symmetric_eigenvectorUnitary_transpose_mul A hA
  calc (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, A i j ^ 2)
      = Matrix.trace (Aᵀ * A) := sum_sq_eq_trace_transpose_mul A
    _ = Matrix.trace (A * A) := by rw [hAt]
    _ = Matrix.trace (diagonal hA.eigenvalues * diagonal hA.eigenvalues) :=
          trace_mul_self_conj_of_decomp A _ _ hU (symmetric_spectral_theorem_eigen A hA)
    _ = Matrix.trace (diagonal fun i => hA.eigenvalues i * hA.eigenvalues i) := by
          rw [Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
    _ = ∑ i, (hA.eigenvalues i) ^ 2 := by
          rw [Matrix.trace_diagonal]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring

end Lattice

name: prune_chain_error
doc:
n 层剪枝模型端到端误差（抽象 δᵢ 版）：每层剪枝算子误差
‖matCLME (Ap i) − matCLME (A i)‖ ≤ δ i（i < k）⟹ 前向误差
‖quantFwd (Ap 层) k x − quantFwd (A 层) k x‖
≤ Σ_{i<k} (∏_{j∈Ioo i k} ‖matCLME (Ap j)‖)·δ i·(∏_{j<i} ‖matCLME (A j)‖)·‖x‖。
直接实例化 RealQuantizedError.quantized_chain_error_closed（剪枝 = 量化特例：
被剪分量 → 0，即量化到零的 Wq = pruneMatrix A S）。
stmt:
theorem prune_chain_error (A Ap : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (δ : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (hδ : ∀ i, i < k → ‖matCLME (Ap i) - matCLME (A i)‖ ≤ δ i) :
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      ‖quantFwd (fun i => matCLME (Ap i)) k x - quantFwd (fun i => matCLME (A i)) k x‖
        ≤ ∑ i in Finset.range k,
            (∏ j in Finset.Ioo i k, ‖matCLME (Ap j)‖) * δ i
              * (∏ j in Finset.range i, ‖matCLME (A j)‖) * ‖x‖
proof:
by
  intro x
  exact quantized_chain_error_closed (fun i => matCLME (A i)) (fun i => matCLME (Ap i)) δ k hδ x

name: gershgorin_bound
doc:
定理一（Gershgorin）：实特征值落在某个 Gershgorin 圆盘内：
∃ i，|μ − Aᵢᵢ| ≤ Σ_{j≠i}|Aᵢⱼ|。
stmt:
theorem gershgorin_bound (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (μ : ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (h : HasRealEigenpair A μ x) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, |μ - A i i| ≤ ∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i j|
proof:
by
  obtain ⟨hxne, hxeq⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := exists_coord_ne_zero hxne
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin n) := ⟨i₀⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hmax⟩ := exists_max_coord x
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
                                 
  have hcoord : (∑ j : Fin n, A i j * x j) = μ * x i := by
    have h1 : matvecE A x i = (μ • x) i := by rw [hxeq]
    simpa [matvecE] using h1
                         
  have hxi : x i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hall : ∀ j : Fin n, x j = 0 := by
      intro j
      have hj : |x j| ≤ 0 := by
        have := hmax j
        rw [h0, abs_zero] at this
        exact this
      exact abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hj (abs_nonneg _))
    exact hi₀ (hall i₀)
                                        
  have hsplit : (∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), A i j * x j) = (μ - A i i) * x i := by
    have h1 := Finset.sum_eq_sum_diff_singleton_add (Finset.mem_univ i) (fun j => A i j * x j)
    rw [hcoord] at h1
    have h2 : (∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), A i j * x j) =
        ∑ j in (Finset.univ \ {i}), A i j * x j := by
      simp [Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase]
    rw [h2]
    linarith
                  
  have habs : |μ - A i i| * |x i| ≤
      (∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i j|) * |x i| := by
    calc
      |μ - A i i| * |x i| = |(μ - A i i) * x i| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
      _ = |∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), A i j * x j| := by rw [hsplit]
      _ ≤ ∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i j * x j| :=
            Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ = ∑ j in (Finset.univ.erase i), |A i

name: opNorm_diagonal_pow
doc: 对角矩阵的幂仍是对角矩阵，其算子范数 = 谱半径的幂。

theorem opNorm_diagonal_pow (d : Fin n → ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖matCLME ((Matrix.diagonal d) ^ k)‖ = (diagRadius d) ^ k
proof:
by
  rw [Matrix.diagonal_pow, opNorm_diagonal]
  exact diagRadius_pow d k
